title: Hearty Argentinian Freekeh Pilaf
description: A dense and citrusy Argentinian-inspired pilaf featuring freekeh and perfect for kids. Perfect meal for a weeknight dinner.

ingredients.name: Zest of 1 orange
ingredients.notes: Use a vegetable peeler to get the orange zest

instructions: Rinse the freekeh and soak it in water for 30 minutes. Drain and set aside.
In a large oven-safe skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat. Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for another minute.
Add the ground beef and cook until browned, breaking it up with a spoon as it cooks.
Add the soaked freekeh, orange zest, orange juice, salt, and pepper to the skillet. Stir to combine.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 25 minutes.
Remove the skillet from the oven and stir in the chopped fresh cilantro.
Serve hot, garnished with additional cilantro if desired.
Use a lazy susan spinner to serve. This will make it easy to serve a large group of people.
Garnish with lemon wedges if desired, but not necessary.
